title: "Homework 3."
output: html_document
---

```{r houseprices-setup, include=FALSE}
library(AER)
library(knitr)

data("HousePrices", package = "AER")
hp_model <- lm(log(price) ~ bedrooms, data = HousePrices)
```

The standard deviation is $\sigma$ and the sample mean is $\bar{x}$.

$$
\hat{y}_i = \hat{\alpha} + \hat{\beta}x_i
$$

$$
\bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_i
$$

The model relates the log of sale price to the number of bedrooms:

$$
\log(\text{price}_i) = \alpha + \beta\,\text{bedrooms}_i + \varepsilon_i
$$

The fitted equation is:

$$
\widehat{\log(\text{price}_i)} =
`r round(coef(hp_model)[1], 3)` +
`r round(coef(hp_model)[2], 4)`\,\text{bedrooms}_i
$$

One additional bedroom is associated with an estimated `r round(100 * (exp(coef(hp_model)[2]) - 1), 1)`% change in sale price in this model.

```{r descriptive-table}
describe <- function(x) {
  c(
    N = length(x),
    Mean = mean(x),
    SD = sd(x),
    Minimum = min(x),
    Median = median(x),
    Maximum = max(x)
  )
}

desc <- rbind(
  "Sale price (dollars)" = describe(HousePrices$price),
  "Lot size (square feet)" = describe(HousePrices$lotsize)
)

knitr::kable(
  desc,
  caption = "Descriptive statistics for sale price and lot size.",
  col.names = c("N", "Mean", "SD", "Minimum", "Median", "Maximum"),
  digits = c(0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2)
)
```

```{r coefficient-table}
coefs <- summary(hp_model)$coefficients
rownames(coefs) <- c("Intercept", "Number of bedrooms")
colnames(coefs) <- c("Estimate", "Std. error", "t statistic", "p-value")

knitr::kable(
  coefs,
  caption = "Regression of log sale price on number of bedrooms.",
  digits = 4
)
```
